headline: As of 2026-11-14: 75,728,903 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+4.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 75,728,903 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+4.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (11,308,974), Texas (8,151,061), Florida (8,117,814).
